decisions.structure: CSharp readonly array view consumes the evaluated runtime array; mutable fixed borrowing retains the same payload pointer/length for all admitted fixed runtime shapes. Current CSharp17 has zero warnings and caller-visible mutable effects.
decisions.branches: Owned parameters use canonical writeValue aliases. Readonly reference parameters have an emitted loaded aggregate %v from emitExpression; generic writeValue intentionally yields their pointer identity in other contexts. Slice conversion must select that loaded value, not the pointer. Mutable and fixed-array paths remain covered.
decisions.logic: Reuse referenceValueTypeId to distinguish already materialized reference reads from owned values in a small slice operand writer. Do not change the global value/pointer ABI, emit duplicate loads, reconstruct values, or rewrite original487.
decisions.diagnostics: Original487 first undefined SSA is fixed, but V1 now exposes ptr %arg6 versus array value. Actual LLVM already defines the correct loaded %v219246 before that use. Keep both failures and original inputs; old5 source/native passes do not close the root.
